tools.Name: Claude Code
tools.Description: An agentic coding tool that resides in the terminal, capable of understanding the codebase to assist with coding tasks, git workflows, and code explanation.
tools.Use_Case: Accelerating software development cycles through natural language commands and automated routine tasks.

tools.Name: MarkItDown
tools.Description: A Python-based utility that converts a wide array of file formats (PDF, Office, Images, Audio, etc.) into Markdown specifically for use in LLM pipelines.
tools.Use_Case: Pre-processing and formatting unstructured document data for ingestion into AI models.

tools.Name: CodeBoarding
tools.Description: A tool that generates interactive architecture diagrams and component-level documentation for codebases by combining static analysis with LLM reasoning.
tools.Use_Case: Visualizing complex codebases and maintaining architecture documentation while agents perform work.
